name: Benchmark Functions (Supplement 5)
description: Source code implementing a set of benchmark functions used to evaluate cybersecurity vulnerability detection methods.
reputation: Supplementary implementation accompanying a PeerJ Computer Science article; primarily used by the paper's authors with limited evidence of wider community adoption.
notes: Supplementary code rather than a standardized, widely adopted benchmark; intended as utility/benchmark functions for vulnerability-detection experiments. Small/custom scope and limited adoption outside the originating paper; non-LLM benchmark.
